 KELO Sioux Falls Follow No. 8 USD welcomes No. 6 UND for FCS top-ten clash
 Brevin Monroe Wed, October 21, 2026 at 3:02 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. VERMILLION, S.D. (KELO) — The South Dakota Coyotes football team has played some good ball so far under first year Head Coach Matt Vitzthum, and the team will be put to the test once again this weekend.
 The eighth-ranked USD Coyotes are preparing to host No. 6 North Dakota in an FCS top ten matchup.
 The Coyotes picked up a big road win over Murray State last weekend, 49-20, thanks to a rushing attack that saw four different players score, while Austyn Modrzewski tossed three more touchdowns through the air.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This weekend, the competition ramps up with a Fighting Hawks squad coming off a win over then number one SDSU and Coach Vitzthum knows this is just the beginning of a gauntlet for his team.
 "It's going to be a fun four to five weeks here. We're really excited. I told the staff this morning, I'm just, I'm really giddy. I really am. I know, I just, I love this team. I love where we're at in this point in the season. I think we're getting better. We have tremendous opportunities in front of us. We get a chance to play at home this weekend against a really respected team and a team that's going to give us their best punch," Vitzthum said
 The Coyotes and Fighting Hawks kick off their top-ten matchup Saturday at 1:00PM inside the Dakota Dome in Vermillion.
